limitations: command start includes admission/transport/JSON overhead and is a conservative backend upper bound; it is not input-to-visible acknowledgment
fresh means a fresh owned session with the reference circuit prepared; OS/filesystem caches are not purged and process-launch time is excluded
warm means one owned session after an unmeasured edit/Verify; successful records are excluded from project retention between repetitions and may be evicted by the ordinary bounded store
the three reference families, DC/pulse NPN variants and a mixed flasher are tested on one recorded workstation; no universal hardware or UI performance claim
